_comment: The parameter points each task is MEASURED at by score/points.py, besides the scored one. UNTRUSTED and not hashed by the checker: this is measurement only. Every proof holds at every point of the task's range, so a point here is the same proved design at other parameters; the ranked board stays at task.json's scoring.params, which must be one of the points (score/test_points.py checks it). The numbers are written to score/measured/<task>.json, which the site reads ('measured, not ranked').

Per task: `points`, each {params, label?}: `label` names a multi-parameter point ('binary32'); without one the site writes 'N = 8'. `scale`: the parameter the scaling view puts on its x axis (default: the task's only parameter), `scale_label` the axis title. `families`: fixed-size baselines generated once per size (one file per point), drawn as one line of the scaling view under the family's name (none now: a design right at one size cannot be proved for the task's statement, and every baseline is proved, decided 2026-11-12). `skip`: (design, point) pairs that are not measured, each with the reason and the measurement it rests on.

The designs: every proved reference of task.json (one is par's design, leaderboard/par.json; the others are entries once recorded), every baseline of tests/expected.json (each a proved design that names its proof, `lean`: a comparison design when it has a banned operator, else an entry once recorded; a baseline with `banlist_points` is a fixed-size design and is measured at those points only), and with `--records` the players' leaderboard records. Together they cover every design of score/tests/ppa/designs.json (checked). A point other than the scored one whose flow fails or does not finish within the task's time limit (task.json `time_limit_s`) is dropped for that design and the data says so; the scored point has no limit beyond the pinned flow's own.

fdivp._timings: Wall time of the pinned flow (score/points.py measure --timings, 2026-11-05, nice 19, load average 7 to 8, Apple M2 Pro): binary32 fdivp 9.1 s, fdivp_d1 9.1 s, fdivp_d2 30.1 s, all inside the 120 s limit of then; fdivp_newton stopped at 120 s (skipped below; again at 300 s, the limit since 2026-11-06, on 2026-11-12). bfloat16: fdivp 1.4 s, fdivp_newton 9.0 s, fdivp_d1 1.3 s, fdivp_d2 1.5 s. binary16 (the scored point, no limit): fdivp_newton 62.0 s, every other design under 2.2 s.

skip.reason: the pinned flow did not finish within the task's time limit (300 s)
skip.measured: 2026-11-12: stopped at 300 s, the task's time limit since 2026-11-06 (score/points.py measure --retry-skipped, nice 19, load average 6 to 11, Apple M2 Pro, Yosys 0.53 the rating build); 2026-11-05: stopped at 120 s, the limit then; tests/expected.json: more than 30 min (&fraig -x on the multipliers)
